properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Emergency permissive dominates mode and buttons.
A held button cannot repeatedly toggle; applies independently to all five buttons.
A closes and B opens at or above 50cm.
Mix completion stops mixing and opens D.
Extends P2 manual coverage from valveA to all five actuators (A, B, C, D, Mix).
Guarantees single-actuator automatic progression and mode-change isolation.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

atomic_propositions.toggle: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND NOT opeMode AND rising(valveAStart))
atomic_propositions.held: safe AND NOT opeMode AND NOT rising(valveAStart) AND no mode change
atomic_propositions.toB: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_A AND levelSensor>=50)
atomic_propositions.toMix: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND NOT latched_batch_mode)
atomic_propositions.toC: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND latched_batch_mode)
atomic_propositions.fromC: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_C AND levelSensor>=100)
atomic_propositions.mixed: No mode change this invocation AND (safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase MIX AND mixMotorComplete)
atomic_propositions.CompleteBehavior:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB015(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
五按钮及autoStart历史初值FALSE、每拍更新。急停优先，其次已建立模式的变化；二者清阶段/五锁存且当拍全关。手动逐项latchAfter=latchBefore XOR buttonRise。自动IDLE或DRAIN遇autoStartRise进A（新批次），A液位>=50进B，B>=80按批次processMode进C或MIX，C>=100进MIX，MIX完成进DRAIN；每拍一阶，DRAIN保持valveDRun=TRUE至切换手动、急停或autoStart上升沿重起。五输出对应转移后A/B/C/DRAIN/MIX。批次模式在活动批次(1..4)内固定。

atomic_propositions.valveBRun: O[k].valveBRun: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.valveCRun: O[k].valveCRun: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.valveDRun: O[k].valveDRun: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.mixMotorRun: O[k].mixMotorRun: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.

atomic_propositions.manual_toggles: Each of valveARun/B/C/D/mixMotorRun toggles XOR on its own button rising edge and holds otherwise while in Manual without modeChanged.
